# NoteCountingMachines.com

> Dealer of note counting machines with fake note detection in New Delhi, serving Delhi NCR (Delhi, Gurgaon, Noida, Faridabad, Ghaziabad). Free demo, 1-year onsite warranty on Pacific International machines, GST invoice.

## Machines and MRP (incl. GST)
- T-800 Mix Value Note Counting Machine (Pacific International): ₹24,990. Totals mixed denominations; UV, MG, IR, MT detection; 1,200 notes/min; 250-note hopper.
- T-100 Semi Value Note Counting Machine (Pacific International): ₹13,990. UV, MG, IR, MT; 1,200 notes/min.
- Kores EasyCount 442 Note Counting Machine: ₹13,750. UV, MG, IR; 900 notes/min; 5-hour continuous run.
